svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 720 mm of 60 x 40 x 2 mm tube; square and deburr the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay it with a 60 mm face up. All holes 6.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gusset bolt holes, horizontal through both 40 mm sides, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mid-height: 20 mm and 75 mm in from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turntable bolt holes, vertical through top and bottom: four holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 mm each side of the centre and 15 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide a 6 mm bore aluminum crush sleeve into each bolt hole pair

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (cut to the inside height) so bolts do not crush the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits flat on the turntable disc, held by four M6 bolts into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the disc's tapped holes; the arms stand on its ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: holes in line; the tube lies flat on the disc.
